message: Active renin acts upon its substrate, angiotensinogen, to generate angiotensin I (Ang I).
socratic_question: What circulating protein substrate does active renin act upon in the bloodstream to generate angiotensin I?
hints: Recall that renin is synthesized as an inactive prohormone in the afferent arterioles and then released into the circulation as an active proteolytic enzyme.
The rate-limiting step of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system involves the enzymatic action of renin on a circulating globulin produced by the liver.
Review the initial step of the enzymatic cascade that converts angiotensinogen into angiotensin I.
